autonomy.note: Skips Claude Code's tool-approval prompts; intended for container sandboxes with no internet access. Only ever used inside the box.

verified.notes: In version 2.1.330, @anthropic-ai/claude-code is a wrapper whose command is a 500-byte stub until its postinstall script copies the native program out of @anthropic-ai/claude-code-linux-x64. Like OpenCode, the lockfile pins the Linux x64 platform package directly and installs with scripts off. Configured through ~/.claude/settings.json and ~/.claude.json with ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL pointing at the gateway, which translates /v1/messages and /v1/messages/count_tokens to the engine's /v1/chat/completions; claude -p answers through the gateway with 0 blocked proxy requests when the network is off.
